verdict.rationale: Checkout.com Issuing's marketing docs say cardholders can add cards to Apple Pay and Google Pay through in-app (push) and manual provisioning, which covers the core push path and the manual fallback. There is no developer-level documentation of the entitlements process, and the card-design claims concern physical cards, not in-wallet card art. Missing for 10: documented Apple/Google push-provisioning entitlements process, SDK/API details for in-app provisioning, in-wallet card art configuration, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cards land in Apple Pay and Google Pay — push provisioning from my app with the entitlements process documented, plus in-wallet card art and manual provisioning as a fallback

citations.quote: Cardholders can easily add their cards to Apple Pay and Google Pay wallets – whether on smartphones or wearable devices – using in-app and manual provisioning methods.
